objectives: Usar el formato y las preguntas para escanear textos cotidianos.
Distinguir condiciones, excepciones y fechas límite.
Responder preguntas de propósito, detalle e inferencia en < 90 s por texto.

words: Errors can occur when data is entered manually.
About forty percent of students work part-time.
During this period the city grew rapidly.
a plan or rule adopted by an organization
The university has a strict attendance policy.
The principle of fairness guides the decision.
You may proceed to the next section.
a series of steps to achieve a result
This course requires prior knowledge of statistics.
careful study to discover new information

practice.title: Texto 1 · Aviso de residencia
practice.passage:
NOTICE TO RESIDENTS — Block C Kitchen Cleaning

Starting Monday, November 9, the shared kitchen on each floor of Block C will be cleaned by an outside company every Tuesday and Friday between 8:00 and 10:00 a.m. During these hours the kitchen will be closed.

Please remove all personal items from the counters and the drying rack by 7:45 a.m. on cleaning days. Items left on surfaces will be placed in the "lost and found" box at the front desk and kept for two weeks.

Food in the refrigerators must be labeled with your name and the date. Unlabeled items will be thrown away every Friday.

Questions? Email residence@campushousing.example.

items.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce a new cleaning schedule and rules for the kitchens
To advertise a new cleaning company
To ask residents to cook less
To report a problem with the refrigerators
items.explain: El aviso informa de horarios de limpieza y normas para los residentes.

items.q: What should residents do by 7:45 a.m. on cleaning days?
options: Wash their dishes in their rooms
Remove personal items from the counters and drying rack
items.explain: «remove all personal items from the counters and the drying rack by 7:45 a.m.».

items.q: What happens to unlabeled food in the refrigerators?
options: It is moved to the front desk
It is thrown away every Friday
It is kept for two weeks
It is returned to the owner
items.explain: «Unlabeled items will be thrown away every Friday».

practice.title: Texto 2 · Correo de un profesor
practice.passage:
Subject: Change of office hours this week

Dear students in ENG-204,

Because I will be attending a conference on Wednesday, my regular office hours (2:00–4:00 p.m.) are cancelled this week. Instead, I will be available on Thursday from 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon in Room B-112. If you cannot come then, you are welcome to send me your questions by email by Wednesday at noon, and I will reply by Thursday evening.

Please remember that the draft of your research proposal is due next Monday. I strongly recommend that you bring your draft to office hours so that we can discuss the structure and your research question.

Best regards,
Prof. Anita Rao

items.q: Why is Professor Rao writing to the students?
options: To announce a change in her office hours
To invite them to a conference
items.explain: Asunto y primer párrafo: cambia el horario de atención.

items.q: When can students meet the professor this week?
items.explain: «I will be available on Thursday from 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon».

items.q: What can be inferred about students who send questions by email?
options: They will not receive an answer
They must send them before Wednesday noon to get a reply by Thursday evening
They should send the proposal draft
They need to visit Room B-112
items.explain: La condición: preguntas hasta el miércoles a mediodía → respuesta el jueves por la noche.

practice.title: Texto 3 · Promoción de cafetería
practice.passage:
FRESH BITES CAFÉ — Autumn Student Offer

Show your student card and get:
• 15% off any hot drink before 11:00 a.m. (Monday–Friday)
• A free cookie with any sandwich purchased after 2:00 p.m.
• Double stamps on your loyalty card every Wednesday

Offers cannot be combined. The free cookie offer is not valid on public holidays. Loyalty cards with 10 stamps can be exchanged for a free drink of any size. This promotion ends on December 18.

items.q: Which offer is available only after 2:00 p.m.?
options: A free cookie with a sandwich
items.explain: «A free cookie with any sandwich purchased after 2:00 p.m.».

items.q: A student buys a hot drink at 9:30 a.m. on a Saturday. What will happen?
options: She will get a free cookie
She will not get the discount
items.explain: El 15 % es de lunes a viernes; sábado no cuenta.

items.q: What can be inferred about the promotion?
options: It is only for new customers

quiz.q: Before reading a daily-life text, it is most useful to
options: read the questions to know what to look for
quiz.explain: Leer las preguntas dirige el escaneo.
no later than = como máximo el viernes.
